notes:
🧾 Buy and sell invoices & quotes:
• We buy: ＋ Buy quote (our offer for the customer's items, numbers BQ-…) and ＋ Buy invoice (receipt / bill of sale for what we bought, BI-…) — no sales tax, the PDF has a seller signature line, ✓ Mark paid out when we pay them (cash, store credit, check, Venmo, PayPal, Zelle)
• We sell: Sell quote (Q-…) and Sell invoice (INV-…) as before, with the Square Pay button
• The customer accepts a buy quote from the link just like a sell quote; then 🧾 We bought it — make the buy invoice
• From an offer: Draft → 🧾 Buy quote (link) sends the offer at its cash price (store credit amount in the note); 🧾 Sell quote for cards they want to buy from us
• Filter We buy / We sell, "We owe" total, ⇄ copy a document as the other direction, buy terms and how-we-pay in Settings
